ios.desc:
keep it simple. is a minimal focus timer built for deep work, studying, and distraction-free productivity.

No clutter. No complicated setup. Just start a session and focus.

Whether you’re studying, working, or trying to stay off distractions, keep it simple. helps you stay in flow with a clean Pomodoro timer designed to get out of your way.

Choose a ready-made focus preset or create your own routine with custom focus sessions, short breaks, long breaks, and cycle lengths.

Need something quick? Start a 5, 10, or 20 minute focus timer instantly — no setup required.

Features

• Minimal Pomodoro timer for focus & deep work
• Ready-made and custom focus sessions
• Quick countdown timers
• Focus statistics & session history
• Home Screen widgets
• Live Activities support
• Notifications & break reminders
• Clean, distraction-free design

Track your focus time, break time, completed sessions, unfinished sessions, and pause count with built-in statistics.

Designed to stay out of your way, keep it simple. helps you focus, rest, and repeat.
